children: Colette Kress, who was named interim chief executive of Nvidia on Thursday, plans to meet with employees next Wednesday, the morning after the AI chip giant's quarterly earnings report.

"I recognize that this has been an extraordinarily difficult period," Kress wrote in a memo to staff today after former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned in the face of investigations into his personal conduct.

"We play a vital role in building the technology that is powering the AI revolution, and we have important work ahead of us," Kress added. Her meeting with employees is slated for noon ET, or 9 a.m. local time in California on Nov. 18.
